name: Workplace: contact centre
about: A contact centre or business-process floor, worked in shifts: a dense production floor in bays with team leads among them, training rooms for each new batch, lockers and a check at the entrance, a large cafeteria, a sick room, a transport desk. In three parts: the Workplace: contact centre typology (on the Workplace one), an office fit-out on an RCC shell, and the BuilderPluss standards with the Indian codes. 2.1.0: its walls, fences, railings, parapets, beams, doors and windows in the versions that say how they sit and meet (R156: justify, corner, priority, align), all as before until one is set.
